summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering to a single institutional investor, issuing 3.7M ordinary shares, 4.3M pre-funded warrants, and 8M ordinary warrants, with total proceeds of $8.0M before fees. Combined purchase price per share unit is $1.00 and per pre-funded unit $0.9999; ordinary warrants have a $1.15 exercise price, exercisable after six months, expiring in five years, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation. A.G.P. acted as sole placement agent with a $400,000 fee. Delivery expected August 7, 2026. Watch for warrant exercise overhang and dilution effects.
